rubric_basis: Every current section independently visually inspected at 1440/1024/390. 5 denotes particularly strong relation/readability/alignment in inspected evidence; 4 means coherent source-grounded adaptation with no visible defect, not pixel equality. Text-only units receive 4 for media dimensions because deliberate absence matches defined source scope; no absent image is invented. Mobile score concerns observed recomposition rather than matching arbitrary scroll percent.
repair_history: Lou reading column displacement confirmed by live source DOM and repaired.
Slab source regions prove text-row excludes separate neighboring media; former neighboring-media failure withdrawn on new evidence.
Alpha brief segmentation, full-width opening artwork, separate course dominant-media unit and Believe photograph card repaired.
Beliefs display contrast initially 2.67/2.61/1.95; continuous grade repair rechecked 5.89/5.91/5.71.
Membership phone captions initially 2.32 and1.29; top grade repaired and final caption recheck recorded separately.

motion.membership: Actual browser scroll 1→2→3→4→4→4→3→2→1 at all widths, visibly paired photographs/copy. Reduced motion is static/unpinned with all four articles opacity1. No exact Framer timing asserted.
motion.observer_result: 18 actual forward/reverse/reduced browser traversals across six routes and three widths; once-entry animations fired on forward, zero new animations on reverse, zero on reduced reload.

contrast.method: Targeted screenshot sampling: text made transparent to expose actual backdrop; rendered solid interior glyph pixels compared with same background; antialias fringes excluded. Entire text rectangle worst-case also recorded separately. Membership copy sampled conservatively across rectangle.

limitations: Raw section aspect ratios, full-bleed flags, heading ratios and total section-count assertions remain separate mechanical gate results; these visual scores do not waive them.
Source copy length, intrinsic company assets and church palette intentionally differ; no pixel similarity percentage claimed.
Whole-unit build crops exclude fixed browser/header chrome for unobstructed content review; opening and motion screenshots retain actual header.
No physical phone, exact source editor timing, all-frame contrast proof or owner Accepted status claimed.
Targeted overlay/hero contrast sampling is not a complete WCAG audit of every text node or every transitional frame.
Source Lou first-arrival is observed but per-character implementation parity is not claimed; intact-unit clarity avoids hiding essential copy.
